blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – A man tagged by police as a high-value individual (HVI) was arrested for allegedly possessing suspected shabu worth P1.4 million in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Cogon Pardo, Cebu City, early Saturday evening, October 17. In a report, the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) said law enforcers also recovered the P15,000 in buy-bust money from the suspect’s black sling bag, which was also used to carry the suspected illegal drugs. The 210 grams of suspected shabu was submitted to the PNP Cebu City Forensic Unit for laboratory examination. Meanwhile, police are preparing to file a complaint against […]...
